faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How can I upgrade my subscription?
faq.a1: Go to your subscription page and select 'Upgrade'.
faq.q2: Is it possible to get a refund?
faq.a2: Refunds are not provided once the payment is processed.
faq.q3: I forgot my password. What should I do?
faq.a3: Use the 'Forgot Password' option at login.
